title: A CLO fund is down 27%, plus a look at JEPI vs JPM and buffer ETFsdesigned to protect stock gains
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
Today's write-ups on bonds and hedges cover a CLO fund down about 27%,  
a comparison of JEPI and JPM, and buffer ETFs designed to help protect  
stock gains.  
  
Here is a rundown of those names.  
  
\*\*1. OFS Credit Company (OCCI)\*\* — OCCI declined roughly 27% over the  
last 30 days, extending an approximately 48% slide over the trailing  
quarter. The fund trades at a discount of more than 50% to its most  
recent estimated net asset value (NAV), reflecting deep investor  
skepticism about its holdings.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/ofs-credit-company-occi-drops-27-in-30-days-as-nav-erosion-persists-39027/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/ofs-credit-company-occi-drops-27-in-30-days-as-nav-erosion-persists-39027/)

The breakdown is in the link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/jepi-vs-jpm-weighing-an-income-etf-against-the-largest-u-s-bank-stock-38499/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/jepi-vs-jpm-weighing-an-income-etf-against-the-largest-u-s-bank-stock-38499/)

[https://tickeron.com/blogs/psep-innovator-s-defined-outcome-etf-offering-s-p-500-exposure-with-a-15-buffer-38615/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/psep-innovator-s-defined-outcome-etf-offering-s-p-500-exposure-with-a-15-buffer-38615/)

exchange-traded fund (ETF) that seeks to match the price return of the  
SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY), up to a predetermined cap, while  
buffering against the first 10% of losses over a one-year outcome  
period.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/faug-a-defined-outcome-etf-for-s-p-500-exposure-with-a-10-buffer-38599/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/faug-a-defined-outcome-etf-for-s-p-500-exposure-with-a-10-buffer-38599/)  
  
\*\*12.\*\* DBMF: Bringing Managed Futures Strategies Within Reach for

[https://tickeron.com/blogs/dbmf-bringing-managed-futures-strategies-within-reach-for-individual-investors-38576/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/dbmf-bringing-managed-futures-strategies-within-reach-for-individual-investors-38576/)  
  
\*\*13. Invesco QQQ Income Advantage ETF (QQA)\*\* — QQA is the Invesco  
QQQ Income Advantage ETF, an actively managed exchange-traded fund  
(ETF) issued by Invesco and launched on July 17, 2024.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/invesco-qqq-income-advantage-etf-qqa-targeting-around-10-annual-income-from-nasdaq-100-exposure-38642/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/invesco-qqq-income-advantage-etf-qqa-targeting-around-10-annual-income-from-nasdaq-100-exposure-38642/)
